accessCheck.scope: Available GitHub tool queries only the first page of pull-request-triggered runs; not proof of absent dispatch/push history.
accessCheck.launchCapability: No workflow-dispatch tool exposed and gh unavailable in PATH. No hosted run attempted.

blockers: Five deliberate successful deployment-disabled hosted verification measurements remain required.
Publishing the prepared workflow on a non-main remote branch and dispatching it requires external-action authorization and an authenticated dispatch capability.
comparisonPolicy: Keep all attempts and every successful run, including slow successes. Five matched final runs and equivalent-coverage stage mapping are required; rerun baseline if runner/toolchain/cache conditions drift. Relocated consumer work is not an engine speedup.
